Rashi on Berakhot 6b:1:1.hebrew: וכולהו כתיבי באדרעיה - כל הכתובים הללו כתובים בזרוע בבית אחד, שאותן של יד אינן אלא בית אחד, כדאמרינן במנחות (דף לד:), וכל הפרשיות כתובות בו:
Rashi on Berakhot 6b:1:1.english: And all of them are written on His arm - All these verses are written on the arm in one compartment, for those [phylacteries] of the arm are only a single compartment, as we say in Menachot (page 34b), and all the passages are written in it.

Rashi on Berakhot 6b:2:1.hebrew: משאיל בו - מה טיבו של פלוני, למה לא בא:
Rashi on Berakhot 6b:2:1.english: Asks about him - [Saying:] "What is the situation with so-and-so? Why did he not come?"

Rashi on Berakhot 6b:2:2.hebrew: ירא את ה' - שהיה רגיל לבא אליו:
Rashi on Berakhot 6b:2:2.english: One who fears the Lord - Who was accustomed to come to it [the synagogue].

Rashi on Berakhot 6b:2:3.hebrew: אשר הלך חשכים ואין נוגה לו - אשר עתה הלך למקום חשך, אשר ימנע עצמו מלהשכים לפתחי:
Rashi on Berakhot 6b:2:3.english: Who walks in darkness and has no light - Who has now gone to a place of darkness, such that he withholds himself from rising early to My doorways.

Rashi on Berakhot 6b:5:1.hebrew: ואין עונה - שיעור שיוכלו לענות דבר קדושה:
Rashi on Berakhot 6b:5:1.english: And there is no one to answer - The amount of time in which they could answer a matter of sanctity.

Rashi on Berakhot 6b:6:1.english: The God of Abraham - For [Abraham] established a fixed place for his prayer.

Rashi on Berakhot 6b:6:2.english: In his assistance - In the manner that He used to help Abraham.

Rashi on Berakhot 6b:9:1.hebrew: אל יפסיע פסיעה גסה - לפי שמראה בעצמו שעכוב בית הכנסת דומה עליו כמשוי:
Rashi on Berakhot 6b:9:1.english: He should not take a large stride - Because he shows in himself that remaining in the synagogue seems to him like a burden.

Rashi on Berakhot 6b:9:2.hebrew: נרדפה - לשון מרוצה, משמע שהרודף רץ:
Rashi on Berakhot 6b:9:2.english: [She/it] was pursued - An expression of running, which implies that the pursuer runs.
